articles.title: Why Boeing, GE Supplier Woodward Has Clear Skies Ahead
articles.mainIdea: Why Boeing, GE Supplier Woodward Has Clear Skies Ahead
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Why Boeing, GE Supplier Woodward Has Clear Skies Ahead. Woodward's energy conversion and control systems help to power the Boeing 737 MAX, Joint Direct Attack Munitions and data centers — three of the engines key to fueling growth for the S&P 400 MidCap firm. In addition to Boeing, customers accounting for at least 10% of sales for its aerospace or industrial segments in 2025 included RTX, GE Aerospace, GE Vernova, Caterpillar and Rolls-Royce.
